about: A self-hosted home display that works as a photo frame, family board and smart home dashboard.

prs.title: Long-running repeating events show up on the calendar
prs.broken: Repeating events that started long ago did not appear. The app stopped counting after a few dozen past dates, so a weekly event from last year never reached today.
prs.changed: I made it count only the dates inside the shown window.
prs.matters: Regular events like weekly practice or daily reminders now show on the home display.
